reviews.text: Mike is great. He talked me through some issues that I’m having with my dog and provided me with helpful tips! I truly recommend him.

Mike is great and got on really well with our high energy pup and helped us get communicating with our new family member. We were happy with the positive approach to training working with our pups energy rather than against.

Mike is a great trainer, he is extremely knowledgeable and friendly and gave us wonderful tools to help us get our dog under control and feel better about her behavior around our young child. Can't recommend enough

We absolutely loved working with Mike. He has a welcoming training approach and was so patient with our dog. He also quickly showed us that our pup is trainable. We loved how Mike had us be very involved during sessions so that we could continue training on our own at home. He also has a texting line making it convenient to check in between sessions. We highly recommend Mike for all your doggy training needs!

Signing our dog up for training with Mike was the best choice we could have made! Mike is so attentive, knowledgeable & helpful. We feel so much more confident in communicating with our dog and handling her. We couldn’t recommend All Canines enough!

Mike is truly a gifted trainer and teacher! I enrolled in the Puppy I class and got so much out of the experience. He provided very helpful resources, answered all my questions, and really helped me further a bond with my puppy! Working with Mike is well worth your time & money!
